list.title: API Keys
list.count: {count, plural, one {# API key} other {# API keys}}
list.empty: No API keys yet. Create one to get started.
list.emptySearch: No API keys match your search.
list.createDescription: Provision a new API key (a data-API partner). It starts with every toggle off and no scope, grant access from its detail page after creating it.
detail.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select and copy the text manually.
detail.eventsLoadFailed: Failed to load events for scope picker.
detail.orgsLoadFailed: Failed to load organizations for scope picker.
detail.profile.name: Name
detail.profile.suspendHint: Block every key at once without revoking them individually.
detail.profile.unsuspendHint: Restore the partner, its keys authenticate again.
detail.scope.intro: Control exactly what this partner can read: pick the events (or whole organizations) in scope, publish those events so the API will return them, then choose which resources and fields are exposed. Everything on this tab is enforced by the partner API.
detail.scope.allNativeHint: Grants every AFC-run event (no organizer) in one switch.
detail.publish.intro: Publishing makes an event readable through the partner API. A configured key returns no events until they are published. This applies immediately and globally for the event, separately from Save scope & toggles.
detail.publish.empty: Add events under "Allowed events" above, then publish them here so this partner can read them.
detail.publish.note: Each row shows the event's current state, and updates as soon as you press the button. Publishing again is harmless if the event is already published.
detail.publish.published: "{name}" is now readable through the partner API.
detail.publish.withdrawn: "{name}" was withdrawn from the partner API.
detail.toggleHints.can_read_designs: Background art, placed logos and brand colours for this event.
detail.toggleHints.include_media: Event banners, team logos and player esport images, as full URLs.
detail.toggleHints.include_text: Event rules text and team descriptions.
detail.connection.title: Connection details
detail.connection.intro: Hand the partner the base URL below plus an API key (issue one under "API keys"). Every request must send the key in the X-API-Key header. Note: an event only appears here once you publish it on the Scope & Toggles tab.
detail.connection.authNote: Replace {placeholder} with a key issued below. The full key is shown only once, immediately after issuing.
detail.connection.endpointsNote: Paths are relative to the base URL. Each one also obeys this partner's resource and field toggles.
detail.connection.guideOpen: Open the partner guide in a new tab
detail.connection.guideNote: The page the partner's own engineers read: authenticating, what every endpoint returns, paging, rate limits, the error model and how to handle images. It is public, so you can send this link along with the key.
detail.keys.title: API keys
detail.keys.intro: Issue a key here, then give it to the partner along with the connection details above. The full key is shown only once, so copy it immediately.
detail.keys.empty: No keys yet. Issue one to give this partner API access.
detail.issue.title: Issue API key
detail.issue.description: Mint a new key for this partner. The full key is shown only once, immediately after issuing.
detail.issue.label: Label
detail.issue.successDescription: Copy this key now and store it securely. For your security it is shown only once, you won't be able to see it again.
detail.issue.issuedToast: API key issued. Copy it now, it will not be shown again.
detail.issue.copyFailed: Couldn't copy, select and copy the key manually.
detail.issue.expiresAtHint: Leave blank for a key that never expires. The key works through the end of the day you pick.
detail.revoke.title: Revoke API key?
detail.revoke.description: This permanently disables <key>{prefix}</key>. Any integration using it stops working immediately. This cannot be undone.
detail.delete.title: Delete API key?
detail.delete.description: This permanently deletes <key>{prefix}</key> and removes it from the list. Any integration using it stops working immediately. This cannot be undone.
